llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly searches /home/user/.thunderbird using 'find -name {folder}' for each required folder; Thunderbird stores local folders as MBOX files named after the folder (no extension), so this find command will correctly detect their presence.

Metric correctly accesses expected.get('required_folders', []) directly, which is correct because when expected.type='rule', the framework's get_rule returns config['rules'] directly as the expected parameter (i.e., {'required_folders': [...]}), not a nested structure.
All three required folders (COMPANY, UNIVERSITY, RESEARCH) are covered by both getter and metric — complete instruction coverage.
Partial credit scoring (1/3 per folder) is semantically appropriate for a 3-folder creation task.
No postconfig is needed since verification is purely filesystem-based and does not depend on UI/dialog state.
Folder names are simple alphanumeric strings with no special shell characters, so the find command poses no injection risk.
